title: Modernization Operations Roadmap
purpose: Consolidated roadmap answering: which workflows are automated, how waves are generated, how remediation is prioritized, how Domain E is tracked, and how Domain F is prepared.

certificationCandidateSelection.description: Scans all 5 packs, evaluates structural/identity/governance gates, outputs READY/REMEDIATE/BLOCKED classifications

remediationQueueManagement.description: Groups items by defect type, assigns tiers (T0 Critical–T3 Low), splits into <=28-item batches

wavePlanning.description: Builds domain-balanced waves A/B/C with workload, complexity, and coverage considerations

replacementLineageTracking.description: Tracks original→replacement→certification lineage via template families

seedOperationsManagement.description: Identifies seed items in DL-012 clone groups, tracks readiness and certification

dashboardRendering.description: 8-panel dashboard configuration defined; rendering layer pending

domainFReadinessAssessment.description: Assessment framework defined; Domain F activation pending modernization trigger

throughputAnalytics.description: 7-metric throughput framework defined; data collection via REVISION_HISTORY.md

process: 3. Run wave_planner.js → builds domain-balanced waves A/B/C
4. Waves are presented for human approval per CAQS §1.7.2
5. Approved waves executed via certification scripts

remediationPrioritization.tier0: DL-030 (answer-key errors on Certified items) — immediate
remediationPrioritization.tier1: DL-008, DL-025, DL-026 (structural defects) — before certification
remediationPrioritization.batchRules: ≤28 items per batch (governance-guard Rule 5), backup mandatory

domainETracking.currentCoverage: From domain_progress.json — Domain E coverage pct
domainETracking.openDefects: DL-008, DL-013 in Domain E sections
domainETracking.seedStatus: From seed_operations.json — Domain E seed groups
domainETracking.nextAction: Certify READY Domain E items via wave planner

actions: 2. Inventory audit — count all Domain F items across packs
3. Blueprint mapping — verify every item has CSO topic alignment
4. Structural audit — run identity validation + DL-008/026 scan
5. Build Domain F certification wave per wave planner
domainFPreparation.blockers: None identified — Domain F is the next unscoped domain after E
domainFPreparation.estimatedSessions: 3-5 sessions for full Domain F activation

perSession: T0: Run all 6 engines → generate current state
Tmid: Review dashboard metrics → identify highest-priority action
Post-session: Re-run engines → confirm state change
perWave: Pre-wave: Run candidate engine + wave planner → generate wave manifest
Wave execution: Certify items via authorized certification scripts
Post-wave: Run domain progress engine → confirm coverage gain
